# SAP objects that are not classified as classic API and that SALVage uses all the same.
# One line per object and file: <object> <file pattern> <reason>
# Every line needs a reason, and the README (Limitations) names the same objects.

IF_SALV_C_REFRESH         src/zcl_salvage.clas.abap              refresh( ) needs the full refresh mode; no classic object chooses it
CX_SALV_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND  src/zcl_salvage.clas.abap              display( ) reports a missing GUI status with message 024; SALV raises no classic exception for it
CL_SALV_SELOPT            src/zcl_salvage.clas.testclasses.abap  the unit tests read filter conditions back
IF_SALV_C_FUNCTION        src/zcl_salvage.clas.testclasses.abap  the unit tests name standard functions by their codes
IF_SALV_C_SORT            src/zcl_salvage.clas.testclasses.abap  the unit tests compare the private sort constants with SAP's
